title: Thomas Hardy, Tess of the d'Urbervilles recast
author: Salon
note: This whole-book remake includes sexual violence (non-graphic), infant death, murder, and execution. Period-true to Hardy, written without gore spectacle. Warn the room before you Host it; offer a midpoint pause if needed.
